name: qlrisk_ccr_exposure
title: Counterparty exposure
description: Counterparty exposure. mode='trade_profiles' simulates EE, PFE, EEE, EPE, peak PFE per trade; 'calculator' runs measure ce, ee, eee, pfe, peak or stressed (inputs like volatility_pct); 'wrong_way' widens spreads. Example: {"trades": [{"product": "InterestRateSwap", "trade_id": "IRS-5Y", "maturity": "5Y", "notional": 10000000, "fixed_rate_pct": 4.4, "counterparty_id": "BANK-A"}], "mode": "trade_profiles"} gives Exposure profiles for 1 trade(s); largest peak PFE 623,804.12 on qlrisk's sample market valued 2026-10-09.
